family: One fixed total scale-header language in family.py and engine.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. At large actual N, L=ceil(log2 N) input bits encode S-1. Every scale1<=S<=2^L is evaluated; rejected large plans give zero and the fixed finite small cutoff uses the legacy evaluator. With z=ceil(log2 L), exact parameters are k=P2(S^13 L^15 z^16),h=e=P2(S L^2 z^2),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z^4),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^6),d=P2(S^9 L^10 z^12),Y=P2(S^11 L^13 z^14). Independence order h is separate from binary index alphabet2 with d0 rounds. Initial dimension10000 is fixed and only E1 has A1 dimension z; the four other internal maps use the direct B2.2 half-output extractor with deterministic tower fields, exact weak designs, K>=32(E+ceil(log2 M)+10), and seed O(E^2). The robust map has m=floor(delta*r), w=ceil(log2 r), b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w^2/(30*10^24)), u=2b+2w+10. B5 uses field degree1000w, a one-bit polynomial-hash extractor, and a deterministic conditional-expectation weak-design construction in a universe100*(2000w)^2. The complete table-hybrid proof and polynomial(r) construction cost are supplied, with r=O(log N). Only the hash modulus is design data; no design A1 matrix or weak-design table is supplied. Every header and construction datum is an actual input bit, not advice or witness. Good S0 is used only for a charged hardness restriction; eligibility holds on every header and field string.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^15*(log2(log2 N))^16. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^15*(log2(log2 N))^(16+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(15+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P=L+O(S0^5 L^6 z^8)=o(k). The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.
